name: Doctor's Appointment
summary:
You wake up in the waiting room of the Halbach Clinic with a crumpled ticket in your hand and no idea how long you've been asleep. The display above the reception says 10. A voice calls your number.

Every time you walk through the door, you end up in the same waiting room. The same chairs, the same patients, the same painting, the same hum of the lights. Almost. If something in the room is wrong, leave through the EXIT. If everything is normal, go into the EXAM ROOM. Get it right and the display counts down: 10, 09, 08... Get it wrong and you're back at 10. Reach room 00 and Dr. Halbach will see you now.
